description: The weather over a market: the tone the last 72 h of news headlines set (each headline tagged up, down or flat by Cubicle's house model; the tone and its band are computed in code from those tags, recency-weighted), the headlines themselves with their times and links, the tape's regime (trend, drift or chop by the efficiency ratio of the last 48 five-minute closes) and one word for the sky (clear, crosswind, overcast, fog). Refreshed every half hour. A mood, never a forecast or a direction to trade; social feeds are not read and the result says so.
name: weather
